verdict.rationale: Kong documents a provider-agnostic API (llm/v1/chat) that shields clients from provider-specific APIs, which implies a consistent request schema across providers. Nothing in the evidence explicitly says tool or function-call payloads are normalized across providers; the MCP Proxy turns REST APIs into MCP tools, which is a different capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of normalized tool/function-calling schemas across providers, a per-provider tool-calling support matrix, coverage of streaming tool calls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
